data.one_liner: Automatic dependency injection system for Dart and Flutter without build_runner.
data.what_it_does: Allows registering factories, singletons, lazy singletons, and instances without requiring code generation. It automatically analyzes and injects constructor parameters and supports modularization.
use_when: You want automatic dependency injection without build_runner overhead
You are building a modular Flutter or Dart application
You need automatic parameter injection for constructors
avoid_when: You prefer compile-time dependency injection safety via code generation
Your architecture strictly requires a different DI container like get_it or injectable
strengths: Handles automatic parameter injection and bind configuration
weaknesses: Relies on runtime reflection/analysis instead of compile-time code generation
Fewer community packages or extensions compared to older established alternatives like get_it

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a manual service locator approach without reflection overhead.

alternatives.name: injectable
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer build_runner and compile-time annotations for dependency injection.

alternatives.name: flutter_modular
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want full app routing combined with integrated modular dependency injection.
